entities.summary: Alexander, a notable figure in the history of Serbia, associated with Serbia in the World Wars (1918–1941). Preceded by Interwar Kingdom of Yugoslavia and Serbian army's epic retreat through Albania. Their legacy influenced Bombing of Belgrade; Axis invasion of Yugoslavia and WWII – Occupation & Civil War.
